problem_statement: Return the smallest zero-based index i for which values[i] equals target, or -1 if absent. values is any Python list of integers, including an empty list; target is an integer. Exclude bool from integer inputs. Do not modify the input.
valid_input_domain: Return the smallest zero-based index i for which values[i] equals target, or -1 if absent. values is any Python list of integers, including an empty list; target is an integer. Exclude bool from integer inputs. Do not modify the input.
bug_explanation: Each later match overwrites the stored index, returning the last match instead of the first.
provenance: Custom pilot example, drafted with AI assistance. Not copied from a benchmark; no novelty claim.

human_review_record.notes: Specification, reference solution, faulty solution and named counterexample verified.
